recipes.name: Run 1
dims: Wedge (1/8 of a log), from a 12 in log
Length along the bark corner of the sawn face that lies on the open side
Length along the bark corner of the slanted sawn face

steps.title: Take the stock
steps.text: Take a wedge (1/8 of a log) stick at least 11.11 in long. Write 1 on it in chalk.

steps.title: Cut 1 (first end) on the mitre saw
steps.text: Lay the stick on the sawn face that lies on the open side on the saw table, with the point against the fence, the keeper to the LEFT of the blade. Mitre 0° (square across). Bevel 9.0° — top of the blade tilted to the LEFT. Slide it so the blade just clears the raw end everywhere -- about 0.5 in in from the end at its longest. The offcut, right of the blade, is a tapered piece: 1.14 in along the bark corner of the slanted sawn face, down to 0.50 in along the point. This cut meets the panel's edge (bevelled to the seam).

steps.title: Cut 2 (second end) on the mitre saw
steps.text: Lay the stick on the slanted sawn face on the saw table, with the point against the fence, the keeper to the LEFT of the blade. Mitre 52.0° — followed from the fence toward you, the cut drifts to the LEFT. Bevel 25.7° — top of the blade tilted to the LEFT. Measure from the first cut and mark: 2.05 in along the point; 10.36 in along the bark corner of the sawn face that lies on the open side; 5.88 in along the bark corner of the slanted sawn face. Join the marks across the slanted sawn face -- the blade follows that line. The offcut, right of the blade, is only a sliver. This cut meets the panel's edge (bevelled to the seam).

steps.title: Cut 3 (second end) on the mitre saw
steps.text: Lay the stick on the slanted sawn face on the saw table, with the bark corner of the slanted sawn face against the fence, the keeper to the RIGHT of the blade. Mitre 38.1° — followed from the fence toward you, the cut drifts to the RIGHT. Bevel 45.2° — top of the blade tilted to the LEFT. Measure from the first cut and mark: 2.05 in along the point; 10.36 in along the bark corner of the sawn face that lies on the open side; 5.88 in along the bark corner of the slanted sawn face. Join the marks across the slanted sawn face -- the blade follows that line. The offcut, left of the blade, is a tapered piece: 69.45 in along the point, down to 61.14 in along the bark corner of the sawn face that lies on the open side -- keep it: it is long enough for a shorter piece. This cut meets the panel's edge (bevelled to the seam).

steps.title: Check it
steps.text: Finished: 10.36 in along the bark corner of the sawn face that lies on the open side, 5.88 in along the bark corner of the slanted sawn face, 2.05 in along the point. Measure each against the list before it goes in.

steps.title: Put it in
steps.text: It goes in as run 1: flipped over: sawn face against the open side, point back toward the wall.
